# The Millions

> > The Millions is a leading digital publication dedicated to literary fiction, cultural criticism, and book recommendations for serious readers.

The Millions publishes seasonal book previews, annual reading roundups, literary essays, and interviews with contemporary authors. The site serves as a curated guide to anticipated releases and cultural commentary across fiction, poetry, and arts criticism.

## Key Topics

- literary fiction
- book recommendations
- seasonal previews
- year in reading
- literary criticism
- novel analysis
- book reviews
- new releases
- reading lists
- contemporary authors
- poetry criticism
- cultural essays
- most anticipated
- book collecting
- literary interviews

## Seasonal Book Previews

- [The Millions' Great Winter 2026 Preview](https://themillions.com/2026/01/the-millions-great-winter-2026-preview.html): Winter 2026 book preview with 100+ anticipated titles and authors
- [The Great Spring 2025 Book Preview](https://themillions.com/2025/04/the-great-spring-2025-preview.html): Spring 2025 seasonal book preview with anticipated new releases
- [The Millions' Great Summer 2025 Book Preview](https://themillions.com/2025/07/the-millions-great-summer-2025-book-preview.html): Summer 2025 seasonal guide featuring 100+ anticipated literary releases
- [The Millions' Great Fall 2025 Book Preview](https://themillions.com/2025/10/the-millions-great-fall-2025-book-preview.html): Fall 2025 seasonal book preview with 100+ anticipated reads
- [Most Anticipated: The Great Winter 2025 Preview](https://themillions.com/2025/01/most-anticipated-the-great-winter-2025-preview.html): Winter 2025 seasonal preview of anticipated literary fiction and nonfiction

## Annual Reading Roundups

- [A Year in Reading: 2025](https://themillions.com/2025/12/a-year-in-reading-2025.html): Annual roundup of 2025 reading recommendations from contributors
- [A Year in Reading: 2024](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-2024.html): Annual 2024 reading roundup with contributor perspectives and recommendations
- [A Year in Reading: Edwin Frank](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-edwin-frank.html): Edwin Frank's personal 2024 reading selections and literary recommendations
- [A Year in Reading: Sophia Stewart](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-sophia-stewart-3.html): Sophia Stewart's personal 2024 reading selections and book recommendations
- [A Year in Reading: Jeremy Gordon](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-jeremy-gordon.html): Jeremy Gordon's 2024 cultural consumption and literary recommendations
- [A Year in Reading: John Lee Clark](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-john-lee-clark.html): John Lee Clark's 2024 Canadian literature exploration and reading picks
- [A Year in Reading: Ellen Wayland-Smith](https://themillions.com/2024/12/a-year-in-reading-ellen-wayland-smith.html): Ellen Wayland-Smith's 2024 philosophy and literary criticism selections

## Literary Essays & Criticism

- [Esther Kinsky's Lyrical Elegy for the Movies](https://themillions.com/2025/01/esther-kinskys-lyrical-elegy-for-the-movies.html): Literary review of Esther Kinsky's Seeing Further novel analysis
- [John and Yves Berger's Letters on the Nature of Art—and the Art of Nature](https://themillions.com/2025/01/john-and-yves-bergers-letters-on-the-nature-of-art-and-the-art-of-nature.html): Art criticism examining John and Yves Berger's father-son correspondence
- [Rubies Shored Against the Ruin](https://themillions.com/2025/01/rubies-shored-against-the-ruin.html): Poetry criticism examining Philip Sidney and the defense of poetry
